source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_temperature" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i temperature (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the temperature OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_temperature SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Retrieve the platform-defined temperature sensor objects over SNMPv3 and verify sensor identity, physical location, typed units, scaling and time-correlated readings against Project-approved thermal limits in a declared operating state.
original_method: An engineer enables an SNMPv3 account in WebUI and uses IReasoning MIB Browser Get Next/Get Subtree on an undefined `$target`; Criteria separately require Net-SNMP retrieval of that target.
manual_activity: An engineer must configure and document the BMC SNMPv3 account/WebUI state, establish the intended ambient/power/load condition and approve the sensor/object and thermal-acceptance contract. The agent can then perform bounded sampling and comparison.
required_inputs: vendor MIB module/version and exact temperature object OIDs
raw-unit, scale/exponent, engineering unit, precision and update cadence
ambient, host power/load/fan state and stabilization window
normal, warning and critical thresholds plus tolerances
SNMPv3 security profile via protected secret injection and manager ACL
approved client equivalence and cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Do not enable SNMPv3 or create/change the BMC user until the account, ACL and restore policy are approved.
Never expose authentication/privacy secrets; do not substitute v2c for the source SNMPv3 method.
Do not use the generic `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8072...` example or grep-only/empty output as temperature evidence.
Bound queries to approved read-only objects and preserve types, indexes, timestamps, units and errors.
Stop and escalate on warning/critical temperature, cooling anomaly, implausible conversion or BMC instability; do not continue a load condition or retry automatically.
Do not change fan, cooling or power policy; restore temporary SNMPv3 configuration and verify health.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, resolve approved vendor MIB objects and sample exact SNMPv3 temperature OIDs for the approved interval with full typed timestamps.
Apply only documented conversions and compare readings, thresholds and alarm states with ambient/load/fan context and independent telemetry.
Do not operate WebUI, create load, alter cooling/power controls, claim IReasoning coverage when only Net-SNMP ran or issue a DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply and approve the sensor/OID/index/location/type/unit/scale map, state/window and thermal limits.
Establish and monitor the safe ambient/power/load/fan state, configure and restore SNMPv3 and approve tool equivalence.
Own immediate thermal safety response and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command uses the wrong security mode, an unrelated Net-SNMP demonstration OID and a lossy grep, so it cannot establish temperature sensor identity, location, units, state or limits.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor-MIB-resolved, approved SNMPv3 temperature OIDs with bounded timestamped queries, documented conversion and full typed output; keep IReasoning and Net-SNMP as separate coverage unless equivalence is approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria and 10/5-minute values remain preserved source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT THERMAL OBJECT AND ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each inlet, CPU, DIMM, accelerator, board or other required sensor to the matching MIB object/location, stabilize the approved ambient and system state, collect timestamped bounded samples, decode documented units and compare to normal/warning/critical limits plus independent telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified chassis/board/population, BMC firmware, cooling topology and matching MIB release.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/board/BMC/MIB/client/sensor-map versions and relevant population.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor thermal-sensor MIB, platform thermal limits and Project SPEC.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical sensor identity, ambient/load/fan state, sampling window and quantitative acceptance without replacing the original client checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Net-SNMP may be protocol/object equivalent when approved but does not validate IReasoning UI; a single returned value does not prove steady-state thermal health.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Sensor objects/locations, conversion, cadence, system/ambient state, window, thresholds/tolerances, reference and client decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Thermal inertia, sensor placement and asynchronous update cadence can invalidate point comparisons unless timestamps and stabilization are controlled.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may select sensors and a safe idle or workload window, and may approve Net-SNMP instead of IReasoning, only while recording omitted sensors, state/duration, original and actual tool, object-level equivalence and any unverified GUI coverage.
expected_evidence: redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
ambient, host power/load/fan state and approved stabilization/sampling window
complete timestamped SNMPv3 typed samples with decoded temperatures
normal/warning/critical comparison and independent Redfish/IPMI/WebUI correlation
tool-equivalence statement, unexpected logs, thermal/BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure explicitly requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 while Criteria switches to Net-SNMP, `$target` and thermal acceptance remain unresolved, and DeepSeek changes security to v2c plus an unrelated generic OID. The temperature-monitoring purpose remains identifiable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Sensor mapping, conversion, operating state, thermal limits and approved client are Project execution-readiness inputs for a clear read-only telemetry purpose. After those inputs and manual setup, automated bounded sampling is feasible, so permanent BLOCKED is not justified.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains PARTIAL execution but rejects its v2c, generic OID and grep evidence and adds exact thermal semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION because the missing object/state/limit contract is obtainable Project input under ED-36.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms the non-blocked boundary while strengthening thermal stabilization, cadence and safety-stop requirements.

review_improvement: Creates state- and time-aware thermal evidence that distinguishes protocol response from correctly mapped, safely acceptable sensor behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: Temperature meaning depends on physical sensor location, update cadence and ambient/load/fan state; none can be inferred from a text match. They must be supplied, but they are normal Project readiness data rather than an ambiguity in the purpose. Manual SNMPv3/state setup plus bounded automated sampling fits REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.
